title: Northgate Optical Lens Treatments and Options: Price Card
content:
**Northgate Optical lens treatments, by lens design.** Scratch-resistant coating and UV protection are included in the lens price of every design. Anti-reflective coating is included in the lens price of the two premium designs and is priced separately on the others. The light-adaptive (photochromic) and blue-light filtering options are always priced separately when ordered.

| Lens design | Scratch coating | UV protection | Anti-reflective coating | Anti-reflective price (USD) | Light-adaptive option (USD) | Blue-light filtering option (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | included | included | not included | 35.00 | 60.00 | 30.00 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | included | included | not included | 35.00 | 70.00 | 30.00 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | included | included | not included | 35.00 | 70.00 | 30.00 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | included | included | not included | 35.00 | 80.00 | 30.00 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | included | included | included | 0.00 | 80.00 | 30.00 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | included | included | included | 0.00 | 80.00 | 30.00 |

An anti-reflective price of 0.00 appears only where the coating is already in the lens price.

### Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

- Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses with anti-reflective coating and the light-adaptive option: the treatments are priced at 35.00 and 70.00.
- Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses with anti-reflective coating and blue-light filtering: the coating is already in the lens price, so only the blue-light filtering option is priced, at 30.00.
- Northgate Single Vision Lenses with no option ordered: no treatment is priced; scratch coating and UV protection come with the lenses.
